name: Meow Squad: Incremental Fishing
summary: 猫咪小队的放置钓鱼游戏，2026 年 9 月 23 日上市，Happy Universe Studios 开发并发行。商店披露只有两句：开发期用生成式 AI 工具协助制作某些视觉素材，且所有最终游戏内内容由专业美术人员创作并复核。八个领域只登记美术一处为已使用，其余七个领域（含游玩时生成、代码、音乐、配音、文本、翻译与营销）本次披露未说明。

aiAreaNotes.art: 披露称生成式 AI 工具在开发期被用于协助制作“certain visual assets”（某些视觉素材），并声明所有最终游戏内内容由专业美术人员创作与复核。本站登记的“已使用”覆盖这段协助环节；哪些素材属于“某些”、是否已全部被人工产出替换，商店页没有逐项说明。

reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商与发行商均为 Happy Universe Studios）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 16），首页没有命中 AI 关键词的主题，因此没有可读取的相关帖。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 6 条结果，读取 2 篇原始来源。其一是 Open Credits 本作条目：该页把八个领域全部标为 Not stated，并称开发者“没有说明用在哪部分”，这与本作商店披露原文里的“certain visual assets”并不一致；本站按商店原文判定美术领域，该页只作为第三方读法登记。其二是 AI Transparency Index 本作条目：该页把披露自动分类，页面自述给出的 95% 置信度是模型估计、不是实测准确率或人工复核分，并把披露原文完整列在下方，属转录。其余 4 条为本作商店页、SteamDB 图表页、一个比价站条目页与一个放置类游戏数据库条目页，均无独立于商店披露的 AI 信息。检索结果为空只说明本次检索范围，不能据此证明没有 AI。八个领域全部按商店披露原文判定，结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。
disclosureQuote: Generative AI tools were used to assist in the creation of certain visual assets during development. All final in-game content was created and reviewed by professional artists.
disclosureQuoteNote: Steam 商店 AI 生成内容披露栏完整原文，2026-11-04 核查；可能随商店页更新。

english.summary: A cat-squad incremental fishing game released on Sep 23, 2026, developed and published by Happy Universe Studios. The store disclosure has two sentences: generative AI tools assisted the creation of certain visual assets during development, and all final in-game content was created and reviewed by professional artists. Only the art area is recorded as used; run-time generation, code, music, voice, writing, translation and marketing are recorded as not addressed.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer and publisher both Happy Universe Studios) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 16), where no topic matches the AI keyword set, so there was no related thread to open. This title was searched 1 time with 6 results and 2 raw sources were read. The first is an Open Credits entry that marks all eight areas as Not stated and says the developer did not say which part of the game used AI; that reading does not match the phrase certain visual assets in this game store disclosure, so this site keeps its art finding anchored to the store text and logs the other page only as a third-party reading. The second is an AI Transparency Index entry that auto-classifies the disclosure and states on the page that its 95 percent confidence figure is a model estimate rather than a measured accuracy rate or a human review score, with the disclosure text reproduced underneath, i.e. a transcription. The other 4 results were the store page, a SteamDB chart page, a price-comparison entry and an incremental-game database entry, none of which carries AI information independent of the store disclosure. An empty press finding only describes this search scope and is not evidence that no AI was used. Every area finding comes from the store disclosure text and rests on the developer own statement, without an independent audit.

aiAreaNotes.art: The disclosure states that generative AI tools assisted the creation of certain visual assets during development and that all final in-game content was created and reviewed by professional artists. The recorded use covers that assistance step; which assets fell under certain, and whether any of them survived into the shipped build, is not itemised on the store page.
